DecoSplosion

DecoSplosion is a bright, intricate collision of decoupage, collage, illustration, and controlled visual chaos. It builds subjects out of layered patterns, tiny decorative elements, bold graphic shapes, flowers, symbols, textures, and unexpected little details, often giving the image the feeling that it has been assembled from a hundred miniature artworks at once. The results can swing from whimsical storybook characters and fashion portraits to ornate animals, surreal creatures, and elaborate graphic compositions, while keeping that distinctive handcrafted, cut-paper-meets-explosion character.
